Title: General availability: Dapr release 1.8 support in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps (ACA) support for Dapr release 1.8.3 is now generally available. All Container App Environments have been automatically upgraded to consume 1.8.3 

Learn more about available Dapr features in Azure Container Apps.
